response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), with_share AS (SELECT count, count * 1.0 / SUM(count) OVER () as share FROM status_counts), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_share) SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share_above, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)) as above_average_excess FROM with_share WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)

assumptions.assumption: Share is calculated as a fraction (0 to 1) of total telescopes; NULL values in powerstatus form their own group and appear as NULL in GROUP BY results
